extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen- or overstep, in file order. No stratum: the commentary does not date its text (chronology entry unresolved).

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-1082): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: To every individual apperception attaches a sense-transcendence, toward new reals to be experienced from the world and, as inner horizon, toward not yet apperceived features.
units.quote: Thus to every individual apperception, to every given total stock of individual apperceptions, there attaches a sense-transcendence (Sinnestranszendenz)

units.claim: Association designates a lawfulness of immanent genesis belonging essentially to consciousness, the purely immanent nexus of something reminding of something.
units.quote: The title "association" in this context designates a form of lawfulness of immanent genesis belonging essentially to consciousness as such.

units.claim: The perceived object is a unity in immanent time, enduring through the streaming phases of perception.
units.quote: The object, as perceived, is a unity in immanent time: it endures through the streaming phases of perception, continuously identified as the same.

units.claim: Everything originally appearing has both an immanent phenomenal time and a fixed position in the one objective time.
units.quote: Hence everything originally appearing, even if it appears in conflict, has its determinate time-position — not only an immanent phenomenal time in the intentional objectuality as such, but also its fixed position in the one objective time.

units.claim: All objectualities, of receptive experience or of the understanding, are given in immanent time.
units.quote: All objectualities — whether objects of receptive experience or objectualities of the understanding — are given in immanent time.

absences.expected_because: The world as pregiven ground of belief is set out here, and §8 attaches to every apperception a sense-transcendence toward the world.
